segmente.text: Most content fails for one reason.
It never enters the emotional side of the brain.
Businesses often focus on logical content.
They post what they do, what people can buy from them, and about their team.
Logical content doesn't necessarily create memory.
That's why people love founder stories, or stories with personal background.
If people don't feel something, they won't remember anything.
And if they don't remember you, nothing else matters.
Comment the word attention if you want to learn how you make your content connect emotionally.
